identity: reuse existing unit/case/behavior/evidence/source/article IDs; new FRSCOPE-SPAN IDs identify only this overlay interval
span_offset: unicode_codepoint [start,end), relative to exact source.text before display normalization
hit: all exact source occurrences of original unit.source_text, independently delimited
supplement: reviewed same behavior paragraph/responsibility or single-behavior table row; no shared actor inference
extended: document identity, optional full source, or local context containing other behavior; cannot inherit hit actor

text_origins.current_candidate_fields: whole document model candidate, not all unit facts

candidate_fields_export: preserve original values nested in current_candidate_fields; absent/null is not false
runtime_rule: runtime_relevance is null in static evidence; caller may append runtime provenance separately, score is not violation probability
scope_noninheritance: existing scope review applies only to exact original reviewed unit and source SHA; all other units of that file remain unreviewed
article_limit: reader snapshot, literal source positions checked; current legal status and historical applicability are not independently revalidated
